name: Abdelaziz of Morocco
contribution: Sultan of Morocco from 9 June 1894 to 21 August 1908, as a ruler of the 'Alawi dynasty.

checks.lead: Moulay Abd al-Aziz bin Hassan (Arabic: عبد العزيز بن الحسن, romanized: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn al-Ḥasan; 24 February 1878 – 10 June 1943) was sultan of Morocco from 9 June 1894 to 21 August 1908, as a ruler of the 'Alawi dynasty. He was proclaimed sultan at the age of sixteen after the death of his father Hassan I.
